_comment: Overrides for the pre-Reforged rune catalogs (DESIGN.md 1.2, layers 2-4), one record per line. Hand-maintained; applied by generate-runes-data.js to every listed patch in [from, to], in layer order (export-fix, wiki-fact, correction) and then file order.

target: a rune id, or "*" (field "stats" only). field: name | desc | base.<stat> | perLevel.<stat> | stats (base and perLevel taken from valueFrom). was: optional guard, the value the source must still have. guard "round4": the replaced stats must be exactly the 4-decimal rounding of valueFrom.

The run fails when a target is missing in a listed patch of the range, when a guard does not hold, or when an override changes nothing there (stale). The applied ids are written into each generated file's header.

overrides.reason: Mark of Precision: the Data Dragon text is stale short text carrying the pre-V6.22 hybrid armor penetration number; the client's own rune data (LCU game data 7.1-7.21) has this description (D7).

From 7.3.1 on Data Dragon (and CommunityDragon) store the raw rune stats rounded to 4 decimals; no patch note, tooltips unchanged. The full-precision 7.2.1 values are used (D8), so V7.21 equals the V6.22 catalog; the guard proves the difference is rounding only.

Mark of Precision lethality: Data Dragon has no lethality stat key and its text says the stale 0.7; LCU game data 7.1-7.21 has rPhysicalLethality 0.88 (0.7 x 1.25, the V6.22 conversion every other lethality rune follows).
